known_parity_gaps: Offender make_finding omits the fingerprint. Rust returns FINGERPRINT_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE. Python emits a finding (orphan, dangling, reused id, or multi-result).
A mapping tool_result payload calls compute_content_hash. Rust returns sesslint._canonical_codec.payload_content_hash is not available and does not hash. Python hashes the payload.
Empty input with max_findings -1 takes the overflow path. Rust returns the codec error. Python emits an overflow finding.
Float and list ids or payloads are typed errors in Rust. Python uses str().
Null tool_call correlation is still dangling on codex-rollout (SL102 finding). That case belongs in known_parity_gaps, not silent vectors.
